title: MargEmbed-Akan: Bridging Twi Questions and English Knowledge through Cross-Lingual Score Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32630v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most information sought online by Twi (Akan) speakers is written in English, making cross-lingual retrieval essential. We evaluate eight systems: BM25, five open embedding models, and two proprietary models (gemini-embedding-001 and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large) on two Twi-English tasks. AfriQA contains 1,221 natively written Asante Twi questions that must retrieve their answering English Wikipedia passages. Bible translation retrieval requires a Twi passage to retrieve its English translation from 6,195 candidates.   We introduce MargEmbed-Akan, a 560M-parameter open query encoder trained from AfriE5-Large-instruct using cross-lingual score distillation. The frozen base model scores each English training question against its answer passage and seven hard negatives. The student learns to reproduce these scores from both an NLLB-200 Twi translation that passes a round-trip translation check and the original English question, preserving

translated_title: MargEmbed-Akan：通过跨语言分数蒸馏连接契维语问题与英语知识
translated_abstract: 契维语使用者在网上搜索的大多数信息都是以英语书写的，这使得跨语言检索变得至关重要。我们在两个契维语-英语任务上评估了八个系统：BM25、五个开源嵌入模型以及两个专有模型（gemini-embedding-001 和 OpenAI text-embedding-3-large）。AfriQA 数据集包含 1,221 个原生编写的阿散蒂契维语问题，这些问题需要检索出能够回答它们的英语维基百科段落。圣经翻译检索任务则要求一段契维语经文从 6,195 个候选中检索出对应的英语译文。我们提出了 MargEmbed-Akan，这是一个拥有 5.6 亿参数的开源查询编码器，基于 AfriE5-Large-instruct 通过跨语言分数蒸馏训练而成。冻结的基础模型对每个英语训练问题与其答案段落及七个难负例进行评分。学生模型学习从通过往返翻译校验的 NLLB-200 契维语译文以及原始英语问题中复现这些分数，从而保持……
tldr: 该论文提出了 MargEmbed-Akan，一个基于跨语言分数蒸馏从 AfriE5-Large-instruct 训练得到的 5.6 亿参数开源查询编码器，有效连接契维语问题与英语知识检索。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MargEmbed-Akan, a 560M-parameter open query encoder trained from AfriE5-Large-instruct via cross-lingual score distillation, which effectively bridges Twi questions and English knowledge retrieval.
